name: Chickens. Chickens? Chickens!
storyline: No story, just chicken killing fun :)
summary:
Fight ridiculous chicken hordes in a fast, casual arena shooter. Move, dodge, shoot, survive waves, chase a better score, and try not to get buried in feathers.

Chickens. Chickens? Chickens! is a fast-paced arena survival shooter where the only thing standing between you and total poultry domination is a varied arsenal of weapons. Fight off relentless waves of angry chickens, build your score multiplier, unlock new weapons, and survive long enough to face the mighty Chicken King. Every run is quick to pick up, chaotic to master, and packed with absurd moments.
Designed around short, replayable sessions, the game rewards movement, positioning, and split-second decision-making. As the chicken horde grows larger and more aggressive, you'll need to adapt your strategy and avoid being overwhelmed. Whether you're chasing a new high score or just looking for ten minutes of over-the-top action, there's always time for one more run.
Behind the silliness is a polished solo-developed project built with a strong focus on responsive gameplay and satisfying combat.
